tasks.description: Add narrow existing-plant manual watering enqueue/retry on the accepted canonical ACK machinery, without a create confirmation or care entitlement requirement.
constraints: Accepted ACK prerequisite is 992c26a. Read the current helper signature; the reference draft predates it and its old active/original-date UUID helper is incorrect. Reuse the accepted canonical identity semantics.

Prerequisite: independently accepted tester-care-record-canonical-ack. Implement only saved-plant repository/store/retry seam. No UI, Today, notifications, SQL, new profile/source import, billing or second outbox. Reference draft is NOT accepted and must NOT be applied wholesale; reuse only correct saved-record guards/API from it, minimizing new code/test duplication.

Concrete missing API: enqueueWateringEdit(.record) throws, and submitManualWatering requires create confirmation. Allow .record for an existing canonical active owner plant through owner-leased durable LocalOutboxRecord before network. Require permanent current bound owner, canonical nondeleted same-owner plant, no pending deletion and no competing manual operation for the plant. Persist operation UUID, exact payload and occurrence timestamp once; future/invalid date rejected. A repeated tap with the same pending operation must not allocate a new record.

Manual record works with no profile/rule, disabled/paused care, and expired entitlement: do not require routineAccessAvailable, dueRoutine, basicCareEnabled, paid access, or any create confirmation. Reuse ManualWateringAction and existing command/receipt/sync paths.

Expose confirmed/pending/rejected/unconfirmed result for retry. Reuse flushPlantCommand exact operation and existing canonical ACK helper. Add ONE shared canonical record identity probe returning UUID/nil by original operation/plant/manual-water identity and valid active-or-voided dates; current Bool(entryId,watermark) ACK method reuses the same identity core plus watermark. Never copy the old draft active-state/original-date comparisons. Accepted creation can be replayed after subsequent correction/undo without reverting canonical history.

New retry distinguishes permanent nonretryable server errors from confirmed success. Simplest safe scope: terminal record dequeue/typed rejection only when onlyOperation matches this record; preserve existing generic post-save error behavior. Never turn disappearance alone into confirmed. Existing submitManualWatering(.record) returns true only when original operation is canonically linked and queue is acknowledged; preserve correction/undo behavior. If terminal dequeue is made global instead, post-save rejection semantics and a regression test are mandatory and may require a separate follow-up; do not ship false success.

Reuse existing disk/test helpers. Add compact meaningful tests: existing saved plant without create proof; first accepted response loss, disk reopen and exact operation replay, one canonical journal entry; no-rule/paused/expired manual allowed; future date, anonymous/stale A-B-A, missing/deleted/pending-deletion and competing manual enqueue rejected; terminal rejection not success and subsequent new attempt has new op; preserve accepted ACK regression for corrected/voided entry. Prefer a small table-driven guard test and a couple of disk/transport tests, not hundreds of repeated fixture lines. No weakened/skip assertions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Actual full Swift tests and build pass with durable saved-plant record API, strict owner/deletion guards, exact replay and honest confirmed/rejected outcomes.
Ordinary Simulator smoke passes; independent Review/QA verify no create/profile/entitlement prerequisite and preserved post-save semantics.
